 THE HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE D.BHARATHA CHAKRAVARTHY  Suo Motu TR.No.15055 of 2025  (C.C.No.1200052 of 2005 of Judicial Magistrate No.I, Puducherry T  Puducherry)

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
For Petitioner : Mr.M.V.Ramachandra Murthy  Additional Public Prosecutor (Puducherry)
 ORDER
This Suo Motu Case is dealt with in an extraordinary manner by the Dedicated Bench, pursuant to Suo Motu W.P.(Crl.) No.618 of 2025.
2. This case is registered for alleged offence under Section 16(i), 16a(ii) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
The allegation in this case is that in the sample of cow milk taken, the solid fats are lesser than the minimum quantity and as such adulteration is alleged.
For the said allegation, the case is pending from the year 2005 at the stage of NBW.

Considering the factual matrix, context of the case, the antecedents of the accused, the reason for absence from his usual place, and the submission that, despite best efforts, the warrant could not be executed, it is evident that even if the accused is brought to face trial, it would impinge upon his right to a speedy trial.
Due to the passage of time, a meaningful trial is unlikely, and no useful purpose would be served.
https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis

D.BHARATHA CHAKRAVARTHY, J.
grs 3.

Accordingly, the case in C.C.No.1200052 of 2005 of Judicial Magistrate No.I, Puducherry Taluk,
Puducherry, stands quashed.
This Suo Motu Transfer Case is disposed of.
